method: This supplemental adjudication converts the three repeated generic questions for each indexed table into explicit author disposition, locator-level context debt, and version-delta debt. It reuses only the table classification, semantic disposition, review notes, linked candidate IDs, source locators and context-artifact references already present in the source queue. It does not assert independent review, complete normative coverage, completed version comparison, or conformance. Normative/informative classification is an author-level disposition and remains subject to independent review.
gate_rules: A table disposition is not an atomic requirement and does not close the surrounding prose review.
An informative example may illustrate a normative rule stated elsewhere; candidate requirements must cite the normative source, not infer a rule from example data.
A table with no linked requirement IDs is not presumed to have no normative content in its surrounding prose.
Version-specificity remains unresolved until a source-backed comparison against each applicable earlier version is recorded.
Independent review must be performed by a reviewer other than the author; this artifact does not self-approve.
